sources_used_for_rules_only.published_methods: Dugger et al. 2026, Frontiers in Ecology and Evolution, doi:10.3389/fevo.2026.1868960

raw_schema_evidence.banding_inventory: Low/High band-number ranges linked to Colony and Season
raw_schema_evidence.age_recovery: Assign natal cohort and natal colony by locating Band within exactly one non-overlapping band-number interval from the banding inventory.

annual_state_reconstruction.season_definition: Austral breeding season is indexed by the calendar year in which November-December observations begin; freeze exact date-to-season mapping after header/date-format audit but before reading behavioral values.
annual_state_reconstruction.breeder_evidence_per_raw_row: BR evidence exists if Eggs or Chicks has accepted code 1, 2, or 8, meaning at least one egg or chick was observed at the attended nest.
annual_state_reconstruction.breeder_season: An individual is BR in a season if any raw observation that season contains BR evidence at exactly one Ross Island colony.
annual_state_reconstruction.prebreeder_season: Before first_breeding_season, an age >=2 bird observed at a Ross Island colony with no BR evidence anywhere that season is PB.
annual_state_reconstruction.nonbreeder_season: After first_breeding_season, an observed season with no BR evidence is NB, following the published state definition.
annual_state_reconstruction.unobservable: Years before first observed return to any study colony are UN; nondetection after return is not assigned a reproductive state without the published encounter-history censoring rules.
annual_state_reconstruction.multiple_resights_same_season: Preserve all raw colony visits for prospecting-choice construction, while reproductive state is collapsed once per individual-season using the rules above.
annual_state_reconstruction.ambiguous_multiple_breeding_colonies: If BR evidence occurs at >1 Ross Island colony in the same season, exclude that first-breeding event from the primary choice analysis rather than selecting one colony.
annual_state_reconstruction.breeding_colony: For a BR season, colony containing BR evidence. If exactly one colony has BR evidence, that is the breeding colony.
annual_state_reconstruction.cape_bird_censoring: 2014-2020 Cape Bird is unavailable for detection-based inference, consistent with the published methods; do not treat missing Bird observations as absence.
annual_state_reconstruction.geolocator_censoring: If geolocator-tagged bird IDs/years are recoverable from supplied metadata, apply the published 2016-2018 censoring; if they are not identifiable from the public data, document this limitation and do not invent exclusions.

prospecting_history.definition: For each individual-season classified PB, candidate visited colonies are the distinct Ross Island colonies at which the individual was actually resighted in that season.
prospecting_history.primary_lookback: Two breeding seasons immediately preceding first_breeding_season.
prospecting_history.candidate_set: Union of distinct colonies actually visited as PB during that two-season lookback.
eligibility: candidate_set contains at least two colonies
chosen first-breeding colony is contained in candidate_set
natal colony and cohort are uniquely recoverable from banding inventory
all candidate-colony performance predictors are available strictly before first breeding
prospecting_history.chosen_colony: First breeding colony from the frozen BR rule.
prospecting_history.natal_indicator: 1 when candidate colony equals natal colony, else 0

banding_inventory_rules.match: Band must fall within one and only one inclusive Low-High interval.
banding_inventory_rules.overlap: Fail closed if intervals overlap for the same Band in a way that yields conflicting natal colony or season.
banding_inventory_rules.season_to_age: Age in breeding season = deterministic difference between breeding-season index and fledging cohort year derived from banding Season; exact arithmetic is frozen after the Season string format is audited from header/README only.

claim_boundaries: PB is an operational published reproductive state, not proof that a bird was actively gathering public information on every visit.
Observed visited colonies define the primary choice set; unvisited colonies are not assumed available.
A bird with no BR evidence is not called PB after it has bred previously; it is NB.
Nondetection is not a reproductive state.
Do not change state rules after behavioral rows are opened.
